original_test_intent: At the controlled 25C condition, exercise the supported PCIe speed and width settings for the selected GPU link, verify negotiated readback after every request, observe error health and restore the baseline.
original_method: Pin AGT and topology, confirm 25C definition/tolerance, record baseline/max link and AER/log state, obtain vendor-correct syntax/mapping for speed 1..4 and widths 1/2/4/8/16, perform one approved transition then status/readback/error check at a time under watchdog, stop on anomaly, and restore/verify original speed/width.
manual_activity: PCIe/GPU owner approves corrected syntax, numeric speed mapping, supported width expectations, 25C condition and restore/recovery before transitions and final verdict.
required_inputs: Signed AGT/hash and vendor link-option guide
Stable GPU BDF/link topology, max capabilities and original state
Approved speed-value map and corrected width syntax/support matrix
Per-step approval, watchdog, AER parser and restore/OOB recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Never execute malformed `pciekinkwidth` or `/agt` literals speculatively
Change one setting at a time and read back stable target link
Reject unsupported value/downtraining beyond approved expectation
Abort on link down, reset, AER/log or thermal/power anomaly
Restore original speed/width and verify data-path health; never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline and perform each approved transition/readback once
Restore baseline and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve malformed syntax and numeric mappings
Approve width acceptance, 25C tolerance and per-setting expectations
Disposition transition/restore anomalies and set PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic prose omits the source's ten transitions, status checks and exact temperature condition.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the decision, run vendor-confirmed speed and corrected width commands one at a time, each followed by exact status/AER/log readback; restore the saved baseline at the first anomaly or completion.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Speed requests 1..4, width requests 1/2/4/8/16 and 25C coverage remain; malformed spellings are evidence, not executable approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a transaction table with requested setting, decoded generation/lane count, negotiated result, link state, AER/log delta and restore status for every step.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic per-step safety/restoration and supplies the missing width oracle only after approval.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Testing only generation cannot satisfy the enumerated width procedure; unsupported values must be explicitly marked, not silently skipped.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Platform policy may prevent forcing some generations/widths; an unsupported transition is not automatically a DUT failure without the approved matrix.

project_override_considerations: PCIe owner defines allowed downtraining and expected negotiated behavior for this exact topology; project exclusions must preserve explicit uncovered settings.
expected_evidence: AGT hash/version, approved erratum/mapping and stable topology/capability inventory
Exact per-step argv with requested/negotiated generation or width and timestamps
Driver/link/AER/dmesg plus thermal/power telemetry after every transition
Abort/exception records and verified original-state restore/data-path health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure contains malformed width/status commands and exercises width, while Criteria specifies only Gen speed; executable syntax and width PASS/FAIL are not reliably defined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The conflict is recorded for engineering decision while static review and later library review continue.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row232 Wistron-AMD GPU-00225-V002: approve corrections for `pciekinkwidth` and missing `./`, map speed values 1..4 to generations, define supported/expected widths 1/2/4/8/16 and their PASS/FAIL rule absent from Criteria, and define the 25C sensor/tolerance plus baseline restore contract. Do not execute malformed or unsupported transitions meanwhile.

review_improvement: Retains every requested link setting and exposes the missing width oracle while adding transaction, abort and verified-restore controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Requested PCIe generation and width are not equivalent to negotiated state; status must bind to the same stable BDF after each retrain. Width downtraining can remove lanes or destabilize the data path even if dmesg is initially quiet. Because the source's width token is malformed and Criteria does not mention width, silently correcting it and declaring any readback a pass would be both unsafe and a coverage invention.
